subject: Post-call recap + MAP milestone: Integration build plan and owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls / structured outputs)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@novushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP milestone: Integration build plan and owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls / structured outputs)

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation on the integration needs and the target timeline. Per our MAP discussion, I’m attaching the draft MAP and a first-pass integration spec. This thread will track the "Integration build" milestone and owners.

Recap (short):
- Scope: SDK integration (server-side calls), streaming for live transcripts, tool-calling for scheduling/lookup, and structured JSON outputs for downstream EHR ingestion.
- Target close: Nov 30, 2026 (MAP target we discussed).
- Dependencies: Dedicated capacity quote from Redwood, your procurement signoff, and access to a dev sandbox with test data.

Proposed milestone owners (please confirm):
- SDK integration (client libraries + handshake): Marissa Cole
- Streaming config + latency tuning: Dev Patel
- Tool-calls (external systems + fallback behavior): Dev Patel
- Structured-output schema & validation + QA: Neha Kapoor
- Cutover coordination & rollback plan: Jordan Blake

Immediate next steps:
1) Sam / Novus: confirm procurement timeline and technical contact who will own sandbox access (suggest Priyanka).
2) Redwood: provide dedicated capacity quote and dev sandbox access instructions (Ben to share).
3) Internal: owners to review attached spec and confirm feasibility + gaps by EOD Friday (Sep 17).

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf, integration-specs.xlsx

If that all looks right, we’ll convert this into the MAP page and add milestone dates in HubSpot.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

---

From: Sam Park <sam@novushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Menon <pri@novushealth.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP milestone: Integration build plan and owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls / structured outputs)

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Priyanka will be the technical lead from Novus and Priyanka copied here. Procurement will aim to finish vendor paperwork by Oct 22 (we’ll confirm formally).

Ordering preference from our side:
1) SDK integration (we need the client lib and sample harness)
2) Streaming (low-latency config; we’ll need 99th percentile targets)
3) Tool-calls + structured output (mapping to our FHIR adapter)

Can Redwood produce a dedicated capacity quote and the sandbox instructions this week? I attached our procurement timeline for visibility. Also — for tool-calls, we need explicit fallback behavior documented if a third-party lookup fails.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Director of Product Integrations
Novus Health
Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf

---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam@novushealth.com>, Priyanka Menon <pri@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Owners & next actions for Novus MAP - please ack

Team — looping you in on the owners we proposed to Novus. Please reply to confirm you accept the assignment and call out any blockers or required support by Friday EOD (Sep 17). I’ve summarized the deliverables and immediate asks below.

Owners & immediate deliverables:
- Marissa Cole: SDK integration (deliverable: client library + integration test harness; due: Oct 21 to support procurement testing)
- Dev Patel: Streaming config (deliverable: perf runbook + latency tuning guide; due: Oct 28) and Tool-calls (deliverable: tool-call interface + fallback spec; due: Nov 4)
- Neha Kapoor: Structured-output schema (deliverable: JSON schema + validation suite; due: Nov 4)
- Jordan Blake: Cutover plan (deliverable: rollout checklist + rollback steps; due: Nov 18)

Blocking items 
- Dedicated capacity quote required (Ben owning with Product Ops)
- Need Novus dev sandbox access and example payloads (Priyanka to share)

I attached a CSV with owner rows in case we want to import to the MAP tracker. I’ll also add these milestones to HubSpot (deal RDW-2389).

Attachments: owners-assignments.csv

Thanks — please ack.
Ben

Cc: Sam Park <sam@novushealth.com>, Priyanka Menon <pri@novushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Owners & next actions for Novus MAP - please ack

Ack — I’ll take SDK integration. Quick question on tool-calls: do we want the SDK to include helpers for structured-output assembly, or should that be implemented entirely on the Novus side with validation hooks? My inclination is to ship SDK helpers for common mappings and provide a validation endpoint. That reduces integration effort on their side.

Also propose a 2-week checkpoint (Oct 5) to demo the SDK harness to Priyanka and run a first smoke test.

Marissa Cole
Senior Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
